A '''cup noodle''' is an [[instant ramen]] product in a [[disposable cup]], first developed in 1971 and manufactured by the Japanese food company [[Nissin Foods]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=The Story of Momofuku Ando and Nissin Cup Noodles |url=https://www.japan.travel/en/my/travelers-blog/the-story-nissin-cup-noodles/ |access-date=2024-07-11 |website=Japan National Tourism Organization (JNTO) |language=en-my}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=History |url=https://www.nissin.com/en_jp/about/history/ |access-date=2024-07-11 |website=Nissin Foods Group |language=en}}</ref> The product was first introduced in the United States as "Cup O' Noodles" in 1972, before being renamed to "[[Cup Noodles]]" in 1993.
